    RCBasic Documentation

    RCBasic is a variant of the BASIC programming language that includes a compiler, interpreter, and a code editor. Mainly inspired by sdlBasic and QBasic, it lets you create powerful games and multimedia applications while targeting multiple platforms from a single codebase.

    Note

    RCBasic is available under the zlib license — free for personal and commercial use. See License for full terms.
